summary:
Our project is a space docking simulation game that lets players experience a rocket journey from launch to docking or landing. The game starts with a rocket launching from Earth. Players control the rocket, manage its movement, and experience stage separation as the different rocket stages detach during the journey.

After reaching space, players control the spacecraft and try to reach a space station. They must adjust the speed and direction to align with the docking port and complete a successful docking. The game can also include landing on a planet.

The main goal is to make learning about space missions more fun and interactive. It helps players understand the basic stages of rocket launches, spacecraft movement, and docking. The creative part of the project is bringing the different stages of a real space journey together in one playable experience.

We also considered making the controls simple, the gameplay interesting, and the missions challenging enough to make players feel involved in the journey.
details:
ORBIT RUN – 3D SPACE DOCKING SIMULATOR

Orbit Run is a 3D space simulation game inspired by real spacecraft missions and the process of docking with the International Space Station (ISS). The main idea of this project is to give players an interactive experience of travelling from Earth into space and completing different stages of a space mission.

The game begins with a rocket standing on a launchpad, ready for liftoff. Players experience the launch and control the rocket as it travels through Earth's atmosphere. During the journey, the first stage separates and detaches, allowing the next stage to continue pushing the spacecraft towards orbit.

After reaching space, players enter a 3D environment where they can see Earth, stars, and the International Space Station. They can control the spacecraft's movement, direction, rotation, and speed. The main challenge is to approach the ISS, carefully align the spacecraft with its docking port, and complete a successful docking without losing control.

The game also aims to include an alternative landing mission where players can control the spacecraft and attempt a safe landing on a planetary surface.

The main purpose of Orbit Run is to make learning about space exploration more interesting and enjoyable. It introduces basic concepts such as rocket stages, orbital movement, spacecraft navigation, rendezvous, and docking through an interactive experience.

What makes this project creative is that it brings different stages of a space mission together in one game. Instead of simply watching a rocket launch or a docking procedure, players get the opportunity to experience the challenges themselves.

During development, we considered factors such as spacecraft movement, simple controls, visual quality, gameplay difficulty, and making the experience understandable for beginners. The aim is to combine education and entertainment while encouraging curiosity about space science, engineering, and future space exploration.

The initial prototype uses HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. ChatGPT was used as an AI assistance tool to help develop the project idea, organize the written description, generate initial prototype code, and prepare demonstration materials. AI assistance supported the development process, while the project concept and creative direction were guided by the team. AI-generated content used in the project will be acknowledged appropriately.

Orbit Run aims to turn the experience of a space mission into an interactive journey that allows players to explore, learn, and understand the challenges of spaceflight.
